body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, learn its lowest Defense and reveal its occupied space through ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, it suffers -1 Harmony against your next Ritualism card until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Divination
rider.html: Rite, 1 Echo: on a hit, bind the target. Trigger: it starts an Action. Echo: you or a willing ally within 2 units gains +1 to the targeted Defense against that Action.
